description: Interior, church, altar, statues, religious figurines, crucifix, candles, men; Daytime view of rustic church interior with vigas, wooden plank floors and 11 men ( of various ages) seated on a wooden bench in front  of the altar; white cloth draped altar with religious figurines, kneeling angels, candles, etc., wooden painted crucifix of Jesus dripping blood,  large full length statue of Mary with praying hands to the side of the altar, a metal shaped Christmas tree-form with candles positioned in front of the altar and behind the row of men.  Raking light coming from what would be a window from the left of the picture plane illuminates the row of men's faces, the plank floors are part of the altar.
title: Los Hermanos de Nuestro Padre Jesus - Penitentes, Colorado - Father Roy
